## Checklist

- [ ] All commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) under the DCO.
- [ ] No real package data or sensitive information is included anywhere in this pull request.
- [ ] New source files have SPDX headers (`SPDX-FileCopyrightText: The Foliolight Contributors`, `SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0`).
- [ ] Tests added or updated. Input-parsing changes include hostile fixtures and a fuzz target.
- [ ] Accessibility checked: keyboard operable, screen reader labels, no color-only meaning.
- [ ] New dependencies (if any) are justified below and use allowed licenses.
- [ ] Docs and specs updated.
- [ ] No new network access, background activity, or writes outside documented locations.
